tools.name: hyperliquid_funding_extremes
tools.description: Ranked funding-rate extremes across all Hyperliquid perps (top positive / top negative hourly funding, annualized), or one coin. Hyperliquid public data only, refreshed ~every 3 min; stale data (>15 min) is never charged. $0.002 USDC via x402 (Base or Solana) from YOUR wallet. Not financial advice.

tools.name: hyperliquid_whale_liquidation_levels
tools.description: Exchange-reported liquidation prices of large tracked Hyperliquid accounts clustered near the current price, per coin. Hyperliquid public data only, ~3 min refresh, stale data never charged. $0.003 USDC via x402 from YOUR wallet. Not financial advice.

tools.name: hyperliquid_whale_positioning
tools.description: Net long/short positioning of large tracked Hyperliquid accounts per coin (notional, counts). Hyperliquid public data only, ~3 min refresh, stale data never charged. $0.005 USDC via x402 from YOUR wallet. Not financial advice.

tools.name: hyperliquid_market_brief
tools.description: One-call LLM-ready Hyperliquid perp market brief: funding extremes, whale positioning and liquidation clusters in one compact JSON. Hyperliquid public data only, ~3 min refresh, stale data never charged. $0.008 USDC via x402 from YOUR wallet. Not financial advice.

tools.name: hyperliquid_feed_status
tools.description: Free. Shows when the Hyperliquid feed was last refreshed and whether it is fresh enough to be sold.

tools.name: get_payment_quote
tools.description: Free. Returns the unpaid HTTP 402 offer (networks, USDC amount, payTo, raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED) for a token check or a Hyperliquid data call.

tools.name: get_sample_report

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_payment_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free. Returns the unpaid HTTP 402 offer (networks, USDC amount, payTo, raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED) for a check." → after: "Free. Returns the unpaid HTTP 402 offer (networks, USDC amount, payTo, raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED) for a token check or a Hyperliquid data call."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
